title: Apex Oxidizing Copper Weapons&Tools
description: A vanilla-friendly resource pack that retextures copper weapons and tools to visually oxidize based on item durability.
body:
# Apex Oxidizing Copper Weapons & Tools
# 
To get the full experience include [Apex Weapons&Tools](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/apex-weaponstools)

Apex Oxidizing Copper Weapons & Tools is a vanilla-friendly resource pack that visually reflects item durability through copper oxidation.As copper weapons and tools lose durability, their textures gradually oxidize, shifting from clean copper to fully weathered green. This creates a clear visual indicator of wear while staying faithful to Minecraft’s copper aging style. 
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/8Yu4wF-y9jc" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Included Items
- Copper swords
- Copper pickaxes
- Copper axes
- Copper shovels
- Copper hoe
- Copper spear

This pack is ideal for players who want clearer visual feedback on tool condition while keeping everything balanced, simple, and vanilla-friendly.
